package.name: sandsim_plugin
package.description: Gazebo Harmonic (gz-sim 8) system plugin that applies sand traction forces to rover wheels using a seedable lookup table exported by the sandsim terramechanics tool (Bekker-Wong model). The plugin reads a load x slip lookup table (drawbar pull and torque vs slip) and applies the corresponding longitudinal force and resisting torque to each wheel joint each simulation step.
